_about: Backup product advisories compared against each version found in the tenant. Edit this file as new advisories or fixed versions are published; the report logic does not change. A product or version with no entry is reported as 'CVE status not verified', never as safe.

advisories.condition: exploitable when the backup server is joined to the production Windows domain

components_note: Veeam components (Backup Transport, Installer Service, Mount Service and similar) carry the build number of the Backup & Replication release they belong to; report them as 'CVE status not verified' unless an advisory above names them.
